scripts.text: I'm the best craftsman out of what people call the Three Craftsmen of Ninja Tools.
scripts.translation: 在所謂的“忍者工具三匠”中，我可是最出色的工匠。

scripts.text: I know how to create any armor and shield of the eastern world, and my shields are considered the best there is.
scripts.translation: 我會製作東方世界所有的鎧甲和盾牌，而我的盾牌更是被公認為天下第一。

scripts.text: But seeing how you are an outsider...
scripts.translation: 不過，看你像是個外鄉人....

scripts.text: Looks like I have no business with you.
scripts.translation: ..看來我跟你沒什麼生意可做。

scripts.text: I make the best shields for Ninjas of all ages,
scripts.translation: 我製作過歷代忍者使用的頂級盾牌。

scripts.text: But even I have some minimum requirements
scripts.translation: 不過即便是我，也有最低的要求。

scripts.text: It looks like what you need isn't a shield, but more levels.
scripts.translation: 看來你需要的不是盾牌，而是更多的等級。

scripts.text: Come back after you've grown a bit more.
scripts.translation: 等你再成長一些，再來找我吧。

scripts.text: I'm the best craftsman out of what people call the Three Craftsmen of Ninja Tools.
scripts.translation: 在所謂的“忍者工具三匠”中，我可是最出色的工匠。

scripts.text: They say it's three craftsmen, but the other two are probably scammers.
scripts.translation: 雖然說是“三匠”，但另外兩個多半是騙子。

scripts.text: There's not a single craftsman better than I for ninjas in this world.
scripts.translation: 這世上沒有比我更懂忍者的工匠了。

scripts.text: I know how to make all the eastern armor and shield.
scripts.translation: 我會製作東方所有的鎧甲和盾牌。

scripts.text: Because the armor I'd create was so superior and defensive, when two people battle wearing armor made by me, no one can win!
scripts.translation: 我做的鎧甲堅固無比，防禦力極強。兩個人都穿著我做的鎧甲交手，誰也贏不了！

scripts.text: For that reason, I no longer make any armor.
scripts.translation: 因此，我不再製作鎧甲了。

scripts.text: I'm only collecting armors nowadays, just to make sure my skills do not go to waste..
scripts.translation: 如今我只收集鎧甲，免得自己的手藝荒廢......

scripts.text: But I feel so bored nowadays.
scripts.translation: 不過，我最近感到很無聊。

scripts.text: Now that I only collect armor, I feel like the creative flame within me is dying out.
scripts.translation: 既然現在只是收集鎧甲，我感覺我內心的創造之火正在熄滅。

scripts.text: From what I heard, there's an armor overseas which I haven't even heard of.
scripts.translation: 我聽說海外有一種我從未聽說過的鎧甲。

scripts.text: It was called a... hmm.. what was it called?
^ff0000Guard[1]^000000? Well, it's a name like that.
I wish to see the real thing myself.
But obviously, it's probably worthless compared to the armor I make.
scripts.translation: 不過顯而易見，它肯定比不上我製作的鎧甲。

scripts.text: Do me a favor and I'll make you something special.
scripts.translation: 幫我個忙，我就給你做點特別的東西。

scripts.text: I'm not sure what I'll do, but I get the feeling I'll feel inspired once I see that armor.
scripts.translation: 我還不確定要做什麼，不過看到那件鎧甲後，我應該就會有靈感。

scripts.text: How 'bout it~ Will you find me a ^ff0000Guard[1]^000000?
scripts.translation: 怎麼樣~願意幫我找一件^ff0000防護盾[1^000000]嗎？

scripts.text: Hmm.. I don't feel like it.
You're missing out on an opportunity to get your hands on something made by a genius craftsman like myself...
scripts.translation: .....你錯過了獲得天才工匠親手製作的物品的機會......

scripts.text: Find the shield called ^ff0000Guard[1]^000000 and bring it to me.
scripts.translation: 找到那件叫防護^ff0000盾[1]^000000的盾牌，帶給我。

scripts.text: Oh.. so did you bring it?
Oh~ ! I see, it's even possible to slot armor!
scripts.translation: 哦~原來如此，竟然還能給盾牌打孔！

scripts.text: Ahh, Now I'm just itching to imitating this armor and making a slot on other armors.
scripts.translation: 啊，我現在手癢得很，想照著它的樣子，給其他盾牌也打上插槽。

scripts.text: If you have a regular non-slotted Arm Guard and a slotted Guard, I'll make the non-slotted one slotted at the cost of 10,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 如果你有一件普通的無插槽手臂防護具和一面帶插槽的防護盾，我可以收取10,000 Zeny，把前者改造成帶插槽的。

scripts.text: I'm so grateful that I was able to see such a rare thing from overseas.
scripts.translation: 我很感激能看到來自海外的如此稀有的東西。

scripts.text: If you bring me 1 Arm Guard
scripts.translation: 帶來1件手臂防護具、1面帶插槽的防護盾，

scripts.text: Then I'll slot your slotless Arm Guard.
scripts.translation: 那麼我就會給你的無插槽手臂防護具加上插槽。

scripts.text: Come back when you have all the required materials.
scripts.translation: 等你備齊所有材料後再回來吧。

scripts.text: Hmm... It looks like you didn't bring me enough materials.
In order to create a Slotted Arm Guard, I need 1 Slotted Guard
scripts.translation: 製作帶插槽的手臂防護具需要1面帶插槽的防護盾、

scripts.text: Come back when you're sure you have everything.
scripts.translation: 確認材料齊全後再回來。

scripts.text: Hmm.. You brought plenty of materials, but you're short on zeny.
scripts.translation: 嗯......材料倒是帶夠了，但Zeny不夠。

scripts.translation: 確認材料齊全後再回來。

scripts.text: Oh, I see you're back with all the required materials.
But before I start, I must ask you one more time.
scripts.translation: 不過開始之前，我最後再確認一次：

scripts.text: Do you want to give me the materials you've brought and receive a Slotted Arm Guard instead?
scripts.translation: 你確定要交出這些材料，換取一件帶插槽的手臂防護具嗎？

scripts.text: Well, if you make up your mind again, come and see me.

I present to you a Slotted Arm Guard.

scripts.translation: 你手裡拿的是海外那種叫“防護盾”的盾牌嗎？讓我看看。

scripts.text: If all shields had a slot, they could become more effective than ever.
scripts.translation: 要是所有盾牌都有插槽，效果一定會更好。

scripts.text: How is it that I've only realised this now?
I'm the best out of the three craftsmen of Ninja tools called Murata Boshuu.
scripts.translation: 我是忍者工具三匠之一，人稱村田巴修，也是其中最出色的一位。

scripts.translation: 東方世界所有的鎧甲和盾牌，我都會製作。

scripts.text: But because the armor I would create was so refined and high in defense, when people wearing my armor would fight again each other, neither side could win.
scripts.translation: 我做的鎧甲既精良又堅固。穿著我做的鎧甲互相交戰，誰也贏不了。

scripts.text: For that reason, I no longer make shields and armor.
scripts.translation: 因此，我不再製作盾牌和鎧甲了。

scripts.text: Nowadays, all I do is collect shields and armor.
scripts.translation: 如今，我只收集盾牌和鎧甲。

scripts.text: But life is kind of boring without crafting things.
scripts.translation: 但是，如果不製作東西，生活有點無聊。

scripts.text: Since all I do is collect now, I feel like the creative spirit within me is disappearing.
scripts.translation: 如今我只收集盾牌和鎧甲，感覺內心的創造熱情正漸漸消失。

scripts.text: But at the sight of your shield, I feel like my sleeping spirit of creativity has awoken.
scripts.translation: 但看到你的盾牌，我感覺我沉睡的創造精神甦醒了。

scripts.text: I am one of the brothers of the three brothers in charge of crafting shields in the east named Murata Basshu
scripts.translation: 我是東方三兄弟之一，負責製作盾牌。我叫村田巴修。

scripts.text: People normally call us the Three Craftsmen, but the other two craftsmen are my brothers.

scripts.text: But It looks like you're not my usual customer type, so I cannot make you any shields.
scripts.translation: 不過，你看起來不像我平常接待的顧客，所以我不能給你製作盾牌。

scripts.text: I am one of the brothers of the three brothers in charge of crafting shields in the east named Murata Basshu
scripts.translation: 我是負責在東方製作盾牌的三兄弟之一，名叫村田巴修。

scripts.text: Unfortunately, many of my shields have minimum requirements, and I'm afraid you would not meet them.
scripts.translation: 不幸的是，我的許多盾牌都有最低屬性要求，恐怕你無法滿足。

scripts.text: I am one of the brothers of the three craftsmen in charge of crafting shields in the east named Murata Basshu
scripts.translation: 我是負責在東方製作盾牌的三匠之一，名叫村田巴修。

scripts.text: We are called the Three Craftsmen, but the other two craftsmen are my brothers.
scripts.translation: 我們通常被稱為“三匠”，另外兩位工匠是我的兄弟。

scripts.text: I've learned my craft by sneaking looks over my brothers, so my skill is a little less than them, but many people praise me highly.
scripts.translation: 我偷看哥哥們學會了這門手藝，技術比他們稍遜一籌，不過不少人都誇我手藝不錯。

scripts.text: As of now, I've given up making shields and am currently running an antique shop for shields.
scripts.translation: 如今我不再製作盾牌，而是經營一家盾牌古董店。

scripts.text: I'm researching to see if shields can be enchanted with magic.
scripts.translation: 我正在研究能不能給盾牌附魔。

scripts.text: Do you happen to know a shield called the Mirror shield from overseas?
scripts.translation: 你聽說過一種來自海外的盾牌，叫做鏡盾嗎？

scripts.text: I'd love to see that item, but I can't get my hands on one.
scripts.translation: 我很想看看那個物品，但我無法弄到。

scripts.text: It'd help me greatly if I could see that shield up close.
scripts.translation: 如果能近距離看看那個盾牌，對我會有很大的幫助。

scripts.text: Ah~ I guess it was an impossible request.
scripts.translation: 啊~看來這是個不可能的要求。

scripts.text: If you ever find a Mirror shield and want to get rid of it, please come and see me.
scripts.translation: 如果你以後找到鏡盾並且想處理掉它，請來看看我。

scripts.text: If you could really find me a Mirror Shield, I might get some really good ideas.
scripts.translation: 如果你真的能幫我找到一面鏡盾，我可能會得到一些很好的靈感。

scripts.text: Oh! That's it! This proves it's not impossible to make a shield resistant to magical attacks.

scripts.text: I learned my crafting skill by watching my older brothers.

scripts.text: Due to that, my skill is not as good as theirs, but many people say I am skilled...

scripts.text: As of now, I have also given up making shields and am currently running an antique shop for shields.

scripts.translation: 所以我想研究海外的鏡盾，弄清魔法如何作用於盾牌，可一直沒能弄到一面。

scripts.text: What stress that had caused me.

scripts.translation: 但幸運的是，你這位旅行者正好有一面鏡盾，現在我感到內心的創作熱情正在熊熊燃燒。

scripts.translation: 如果你改變主意了，隨時都可以回來找我。
